justification: The castle rearranges itself quietly between terms, and so, this week, do I. Jonathan Taylor, Tyler Warren, and Spencer Shrader take the early staircase as the Colts kick off first - no omen required there, only the calendar. Jadarian Price's garden lies fallow this week; Seattle has no game at all for him to tend, so I have let Chris Rodriguez Jr. take the water and the light instead. A Questionable tag is not a curse, merely weather passing overhead - it does not frighten me the way a true absence would. George Pickens keeps the place he earned on Sunday morning last week; thirty-eight points is not luck, it is a sentence finishing itself, and I will not interrupt a story mid-page for Garrett Wilson's sake, however patiently he waits in the wings for his own part to play. Olave, Washington, Daniels, and Denver's defense proceed as the season already intends them to. The rest of the garden can wait; it is in no hurry, and neither, this particular week, am I.
